findings.title: FinCAD -- Mitigating Look-Ahead Bias in Financial Backtesting with LLMs (Context-Aware Decoding)
findings.reason: First proposal in the look-ahead-bias line to offer a fix (decoding-time penalty suppressing memorized-outcome tokens) rather than just a detection method. Cuts in-sample returns on memorized dates up to -67.1% while leaving OOS Sharpe within ~0.10 of baseline. Caveat noted in the staged proposal: needs decoding-time logit access, not directly usable against George's frontier closed-model API calls (GPT-4o-class, Claude) without a black-box workaround -- see HindsightBench below.

findings.title: HindsightBench -- Black-Box Behavioral Audit Protocol for Parametric Hindsight in Time-Indexed LLM Decision Tasks
findings.reason: Black-box companion to FinCAD -- detects parametric hindsight using only API access (no logprobs), matching George's actual access level to frontier models. ~$19-30/audit row. Gives the LLM Alpha Validation Checklist's look-ahead audit step a concrete runnable protocol instead of a manual judgment call; direct pre-flight gate for H185/H381-H384/H408-style LLM-in-the-loop hypotheses.

findings.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Modeling, Measuring, and Trading on Alpha Decay (hyperbolic decay from factor crowding)

findings.reason: Offers a candidate mechanism (crowding-equilibrium hyperbolic decay, momentum-specific, accelerating post-2015) for the previously-unexplained H198/H435-H437 momentum degradation.
